//: Run with `make lighthouse`, or in CI via the `lighthouse` job. Invoked as
`pnpm dlx @lhci/cli autorun` — deliberately NOT a devDependency: it pulls
Lighthouse and a Chrome launcher (tens of MB) that nothing else in the
repo needs, and adding it would churn the shared lockfile for a tool that
staticDistDir serves the built app the way Cloudflare Pages does (static
files, no server), which is the only deployment shape Hifth has. Hash
routing means index.html is the entire URL surface — every view is that
one document plus fetches, so one URL really is the whole app.
Three runs, median reported: a single headless run on a shared runner
swings several points on TBT alone, and a flaky gate is one people learn
skipAudits: uses-http2 / canonical / is-crawlable are properties of the
host and of a public URL, neither of which a local static directory has;
they are the audits that would fail for the harness rather than the app.
None of them carry score weight in their categories.
